summary: Comprehensive UI testing of OrderNest POS Major UI Redesign completed. All features tested: Dashboard operations-focused layout with 4 stats cards, Order List panel, Payment panel, Popular Dishes, Out of Stock, charts. POS Create Order 3-column layout with category sidebar, product grid, order summary panel, billing breakdown, action buttons. KDS page with color-coded order cards, progress bars, filter tabs. Mobile responsive at 375px verified.

issues: Many test orders showing as delayed (96h+) - appears to be old test data that needs cleanup, not a bug

context_for_next_testing_agent: Major UI redesign fully verified: (1) Dashboard has operations-first layout with 4 stats cards (New Orders teal, Total Orders clickable white, Waiting List white, CREATE NEW ORDER amber), Order List panel with search + 3 filter tabs, Payment panel, Popular Dishes, Out of Stock panels, charts at bottom. (2) POS Create Order has 3-column layout: category sidebar ~160px on left (hidden on mobile replaced by horizontal scroll tabs), product grid center, order summary panel ~320px on right with billing breakdown and Hold/Discount/Confirm buttons. (3) KDS has color-coded cards (green for received, amber for preparing, rose for delayed) with progress bars, timers, filter tabs. Mobile responsive at 375px works with stacked columns. Mocked APIs: Twilio, Razorpay, Swiggy/Zomato.
